_note: ILLUSTRATIVE criteria for a course demonstration. They are not doctrinal values and must be replaced by the vehicle-specific data and doctrine of the user before operational use.

wheeled_4x4.description: Light/medium wheeled vehicle (e.g. 4x4 patrol vehicle), illustrative

dry.description: Dry season: firm soils, low water levels

wet.description: Wet season: saturated low ground, ploughed fields soft

data_confidence._note: Cells whose UAS-derived ground surface confidence is below this value cannot be classified reliably and are flagged REQUIRES RECONNAISSANCE unless already NO-GO.

generalisation._note: Patches smaller than the MMU are merged into the surrounding class (sieve), except NO-GO linear obstacles, which are burned back in afterwards.
